fc407062a4033de7.description: Join our Water & Maritime team in Jeddah and help shape high-quality proposals and tenders for projects across the Middle East. In this regional role, you will bring structure to complex submission processes, connect technical and commercial teams, and use data and digital tools to strengthen our business development activities. What you will do as a Tender Desk Assistant As a Tender Desk Assistant, you will support proposal, tender and business development activities across the Middle East. Working closely with our Business Development, Technical and Marketing teams, you will help qualify opportunities, coordinate submissions and improve the quality and efficiency of our regional business development processes. You will manage multiple requirements and deadlines while ensuring that proposal materials are clear, compliant and of a consistently high standard. You will also use CRM data, reporting tools and AI-enabled solutions to improve proposal development, document management and team productivity. Coordinate proposals and tenders: Support regional business development activities and coordinate high-quality, compliant submissions, from preparing templates and schedules to managing reviews, stakeholder input and final submission. Identify and qualify opportunities: Monitor tender portals, procurement platforms and client announcements, conduct market research across priority countries and sectors, screen leads and support opportunity qualification with Business Development teams. Support strategic pursuits: Review requests for proposals to identify key risks, opportunities and potential win themes, while liaising with Business Development, Marketing and technical teams on major pursuits across countries and business units. Manage business development information: Maintain project references, capability statements, brochures, proposal libraries, CapStats and Toolkit resources, and keep Oracle CRM and ABW opportunity records accurate and up to date. Improve reporting and ways of working: Support pipeline reporting and proposal performance analysis, prepare Power BI dashboards and regional business development reports, apply AI and digital tools to improve workflows, and contribute to Tender Desk best practices across the region. Where you will work At Haskoning, you will join an independent, employee-owned international consultancy that combines engineering, design and consultancy services with software and technology. Our mission, Enhancing Society Together , drives us to create a positive impact on the world. We offer purpose-driven and challenging work on diverse international projects, leveraging our 140+ years of expertise. With over 6,800 employees in more than 25 countries, we work together to turn challenges into opportunities and make a real impact on society. We collaborate with leading clients in markets such as infrastructure, climate resilience, renewable energy, decarbonisation of industry and sustainable mobility. As our new Tender Desk Assistant, you will join our Water & Maritime team in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. You will work with colleagues from different technical and commercial disciplines and support business development and tender activities across the Middle East. What you can expect from us At Haskoning, we believe that the well-being of our employees is essential to our shared success. That is why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both your professional development and personal well-being. What we offer: A solid foundation: A competitive base salary with annual increases, healthcare benefits for you and your family, and a bonus based on company performance. Support for your well-being: Flexible working arrangements that help you maintain a healthy balance between your professional and personal life. Development opportunities: Access to a wide range of training and development opportunities, including LinkedIn Learning, learning weeks, external training, regional leadership programmes and knowledge-sharing sessions with international colleagues. An informal and inclusive culture: An open and welcoming environment where people come first, diversity is embraced, team spirit is strong and colleagues are approachable. International collaboration: The opportunity to work with passionate and supportive colleagues in Saudi Arabia and across other Haskoning offices, while contributing to diverse regional and international projects. Are you our new colleague? Then we would like to meet you. Click on the apply button and upload your CV and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. The application process consists of interviews and may include an assessment. If we are all enthusiastic after completing the process, you will receive an offer and we will be happy to welcome you on board. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered. Regardless of your experience, background or other personal characteristics, you are welcome here. Due to privacy regulations, please submit your application via the apply button and not by email. Unrequested acquisition for this vacancy by agencies is not appreciated. Candidates submitted without prior agreement will not be considered. Desired Candidate Profile You are proactive, resourceful and solution-oriented, with strong attention to detail and a genuine commitment to delivering high-quality work. You organise your work effectively, remain composed under tight deadlines and are comfortable coordinating several priorities at the same time. You communicate confidently with multidisciplinary and multicultural stakeholders and can work independently while remaining closely connected to regional teams. You are also interested in digital ways of working and can use data and AI-enabled tools to support research, content development and proposal preparation. A bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Marketing or a related discipline. Between two and five years of experience in proposal coordination, tender support or business development support. Excellent written and spoken English, including confidence in business writing and proposal coordination. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI or another data visualisation tool is preferred. Familiarity with Oracle CRM, ABW, proposal libraries, tender portals or procurement platforms is an advantage. This position is open to Saudi nationals only as part of the company s Saudization programme.

fce95f36713977fd.description: Job description Job Summary The Butcher is responsible for preparing, cutting, trimming, portioning, and storing various types of meat, poultry, and seafood in accordance with hotel standards. The role ensures high-quality food preparation, proper hygiene, food safety compliance, and effective inventory control while minimizing waste and maintaining kitchen efficiency. Key Responsibilities 1. Meat Preparation & Production Prepare, cut, debone, trim, and portion meat, poultry, and seafood according to established recipes and hotel standards. Ensure all meat products meet the required quality, freshness, and presentation standards. Prepare meat portions according to daily operational requirements, banquet functions, and restaurant demands. Maintain consistency in portion sizes to support food cost control. Coordinate with the Executive Chef and Sous Chef regarding daily production requirements. 2. Food Safety & Hygiene Follow HACCP standards and hotel food safety policies. Ensure proper handling, labeling, dating, and storage of all meat products. Maintain appropriate refrigeration and freezer temperatures. Prevent cross-contamination by following proper sanitation procedures. Ensure all equipment, knives, cutting boards, and working areas are cleaned and sanitized regularly. Comply with local municipality regulations and hotel hygiene standards. 3. Inventory & Cost Control Monitor meat inventory and report shortages to the Sous Chef. Apply FIFO (First In, First Out) principles to minimize food waste. Inspect incoming meat deliveries for freshness, quality, and correct quantities. Ensure proper utilization of meat products to reduce unnecessary wastage. Support the kitchen team in maintaining food costs within the approved budget. 4. Equipment & Workplace Safety Operate butchery equipment safely, including meat slicers, grinders, knives, and cutting machines. Maintain all tools and equipment in good working condition. Report equipment damage or maintenance requirements immediately. Follow occupational health and safety procedures. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe butchery working environment. 5. Teamwork & Operational Support Coordinate with other kitchen sections to ensure smooth daily operations. Support banquet preparation and special events when required. Assist the Executive Chef with special meat preparation requests. Participate in departmental training and food safety programs. Perform other duties assigned by the Executive Chef or Sous Chef. Qualifications & Experience Culinary certification or relevant vocational training is preferred. Minimum 2 years of experience as a Butcher, preferably within a hotel or hospitality environment. Strong knowledge of meat cuts, deboning, trimming, and portion control. Knowledge of HACCP and food safety standards. Experience operating professional butchery equipment. Basic English communication skills. Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends and public holidays. Required Skills & Competencies Excellent knife-handling and meat preparation skills. Strong attention to detail and quality. Good understanding of food hygiene and sanitation. Ability to work efficiently under pressure. Effective time management and organizational skills. Teamwork and communication. Knowledge of food cost control and waste reduction. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Compliance with food safety and hygiene standards. Consistency in meat quality and portion sizes. Reduction of meat wastage. Effective inventory rotation and storage. Timely completion of daily production requirements. Cleanliness and maintenance of the butchery section. General Responsibilities Demonstrate the hotel's service standards and IHG values. Comply with all hotel policies and procedures. Maintain professional grooming and personal hygiene standards. Support the hotel in achieving operational excellence and guest satisfaction. Carry out any additional duties reasonably assigned by management. Preferred candidate Years of experience 1+ years Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

fc66de1bc4f7bcaf.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الالمنيوم العربية المتحده، فرع مكة المكرمة بجدة، عن مهندس معماري ذي خبرة للانضمام إلى فريقها. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تسعير مشاريع الواجهات والألمنيوم والزجاج، ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قراءة وتحليل المخططات المعمارية والإنشائية والتفصيلية للمشاريع. إعداد حصر الكميات (Quantity Take-Off) لجميع عناصر الواجهات. فهم أنظمة الواجهات المختلفة، بما في ذلك: Curtain Wall، Unitized Facade، Skylights، Louvers، Doors & Windows، ACP Cladding، Stone Cladding Support Systems، Stick Curtain Wall، Metal Cladding، وGlass Facades. القدرة على طلب وتسعير المواد من الموردين ومقارنة العروض المقدمة. إعداد جداول الكميات (BOQ) وتحليل الأسعار. تحليل المواصفات الفنية والعقود الخاصة بالمشاريع. إعداد طلبات التسعير (RFQs) للموردين والمقاولين الفرعيين. إعداد تحليل تفصيلي للتكاليف (Cost Breakdown). إعداد العروض الفنية والتجارية للمشاريع. دراسة المخاطر التجارية والفنية المحتملة للمشروع. معرفة جيدة بعمليات التصنيع والتركيب الخاصة بالواجهات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات كمهندس معماري، مع تركيز على تسعير مشاريع الواجهات والألمنيوم والزجاج. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات المعمارية والإنشائية. معرفة قوية بأنظمة الواجهات المختلفة المذكورة أعلاه. المهارات الأساسية مهارات تحليلية قوية في إعداد الكميات وتحليل الأسعار. القدرة على التواصل الفعال مع الموردين والمقاولين. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد العروض والتقارير. مهارات جيدة في إدارة الوقت والعمل ضمن المواعيد النهائية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في مشاريع الواجهات والألمنيوم والزجاج. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين المعماريين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في شركة الالمنيوم العربية المتحده.

fc9655563704dcfb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ديار الشرق الاوسط لتكنولوجيا المعلومات عن أخصائي إدارة مخاطر للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يدعم هذا الدور مبادرات الحوكمة والمخاطر والامتثال (GRC) عبر بيئات العملاء في المملكة العربية السعودية. يتطلب الدور معرفة قوية بمعايير تكنولوجيا المعلومات والأمن السيبراني، مع خبرة محددة في الأطر التنظيمية المحلية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير وتطبيق وصيانة أطر وسياسات وإجراءات الحوكمة والمخاطر والامتثال (GRC). إجراء تقييمات المخاطر وتحليل الفجوات ومراجعات الامتثال. ضمان التوافق مع المعايير الدولية مثل ISO 27001، NIST CSF، وCOBIT. تفسير وتطبيق اللوائح المحلية بما في ذلك أطر عمل البنك المركزي السعودي (SAMA) والهيئة الوطنية للأمن السيبراني (NCA). دعم أنشطة التدقيق (الداخلي والخارجي) وتتبع معالجة الملاحظات. التعاون مع فرق تكنولوجيا المعلومات والأمن لترسيخ الضوابط وتدابير تخفيف المخاطر. التواصل مع أصحاب المصلحة رفيعي المستوى، بما في ذلك المدير التنفيذي للمعلومات والمدير التنفيذي للأمن السيبراني والجهات التنظيمية. تقديم المشورة لأصحاب المصلحة بشأن تخفيف المخاطر والامتثال التنظيمي. إعداد التقارير ولوحات المعلومات والعروض التقديمية لأصحاب المصلحة والقيادة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال إدارة المخاطر أو الحوكمة أو الامتثال. معرفة قوية بمعايير تكنولوجيا المعلومات والأمن السيبراني. خبرة محددة في الأطر التنظيمية المحلية في المملكة العربية السعودية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل أخصائي إدارة المخاطر ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم العملاء في بيئات متنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد عملية التقديم والمقابلات.

fcf3bd4ad70242a7.job_title: Director of Housekeeping, Four seasons Riyadh
fcf3bd4ad70242a7.description: Job description About Four Seasons: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us. About the location: An architectural icon in the heart of Saudi Arabia’s vibrant capital soaring over the city in the iconic Kingdom Tower, Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh is a buzzing hub at the forefront of style and sophistication. Redesigned interiors bring authentic Saudi heritage and craftsmanship to life, while our distinguished team provides a bespoke experience through thoughtful, personalized service and hospitality. As Director of Housekeeping, you will be responsible for overseeing all housekeeping operations to ensure the highest standards of cleanliness, comfort, presentation, and safety throughout the hotel. You will lead the Housekeeping team in delivering exceptional guest experiences while maintaining Four Seasons standards of service and operational excellence. You will develop and implement effective departmental strategies, manage budgets and operating expenses, optimize productivity, and ensure the efficient allocation of resources. You will also be responsible for maintaining the highest standards in guest rooms, suites, public areas, and other designated spaces, ensuring that all areas reflect the hotel's luxury positioning. Working closely with the Director of Rooms and other hotel leaders, you will drive guest satisfaction, develop and motivate the Housekeeping team, and ensure compliance with all hotel policies, procedures, and applicable health and safety regulations. Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh Located in the heart of Riyadh within the iconic Kingdom Tower, Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh offers an exceptional luxury hospitality experience in the Saudi capital. The hotel features elegantly appointed guest rooms and suites, outstanding dining experiences, and world-class facilities, delivering personalized service and genuine care to every guest. As part of the Four Seasons team, you will contribute to creating memorable guest experiences while upholding the highest standards of luxury, service, and operational excellence. Main Tasks and Responsibilities Oversee the overall Housekeeping operation, ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness, presentation, comfort, and maintenance across guest rooms, suites, public areas, and other designated hotel spaces. Develop and implement departmental strategies, operating procedures, and service standards in alignment with Four Seasons policies and brand expectations. Lead, manage, and develop the Housekeeping team, including recruitment, training, performance management, succession planning, and employee engagement. Establish departmental objectives and performance indicators to monitor productivity, service quality, operational efficiency, and guest satisfaction. Develop and manage the Housekeeping department's annual budget, monitor operating expenses, control costs, and identify opportunities to improve financial performance without compromising service quality. Ensure appropriate staffing levels and efficient scheduling to meet occupancy demands, forecasted business levels, and operational requirements. Conduct regular inspections of guest rooms, suites, public areas, and other assigned spaces to ensure compliance with Four Seasons standards and identify opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with the Front Office, Engineering, Laundry, Security, and other departments to ensure smooth daily operations and timely resolution of guest and operational concerns. Monitor guest feedback and satisfaction scores, address complaints professionally, and implement corrective actions to enhance the overall guest experience. Ensure the proper management, inventory, and control of housekeeping supplies, cleaning materials, linen, uniforms, and operating equipment. Establish and maintain effective inventory control procedures to minimize waste, reduce unnecessary expenses, and ensure the availability of required supplies. Ensure compliance with health, safety, hygiene, environmental, and chemical-handling requirements, as well as all applicable hotel policies and procedures. Oversee the implementation of preventive maintenance and deep-cleaning schedules in coordination with Engineering and other relevant departments. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service delivery, operational processes, employee productivity, and departmental performance. Maintain effective communication with hotel leadership and other department heads to ensure alignment with the hotel's overall business objectives. Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, professional development, and continuous learning within the Housekeeping department. Identify training needs and ensure that all team members receive appropriate training to perform their duties effectively and consistently meet Four Seasons service standards. Ensure that all housekeeping operations are conducted with discretion, professionalism, and respect for guest privacy and confidentiality. Support sustainability initiatives by promoting the efficient use of water, energy, cleaning materials, and other operational resources. Prepare and present departmental reports, operational updates, budget reviews, and performance analyses to the Director of Rooms and hotel leadership as required. Knowledge and Skills A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Hospitality Management, Hotel Administration, or a related field is preferred. Significant experience in Housekeeping operations within a luxury hotel environment, including leadership experience at a senior management level. Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop large teams while maintaining high standards of performance and employee engagement. Strong knowledge of housekeeping operations, cleaning procedures, room inspection standards, public area maintenance, and inventory management. Demonstrated experience in budgeting, cost control, resource planning, and departmental financial management. Excellent organizational, planning, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and levels of the organization. Ability to analyze operational reports, guest feedback, productivity data, and financial performance indicators to support informed decisions. Proficiency in computer applications and hotel operating systems relevant to housekeeping operations. Excellent command of written and spoken English. A strong commitment to guest satisfaction, service excellence, and the Four Seasons culture of genuine care. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, and maintain operational excellence during periods of high occupancy. What to Expect Competitive net salary in a tax-free environment. Housing provided. Transportation allowance. 30 days' vacation. 10 public holidays per year. Paid home-leave tickets. Complimentary employee meals. Medical insurance. Life insurance. Employee Assistance Program. Worldwide complimentary room nights with Four Seasons. Laundry and dry-cleaning services for provided work

fc1faf62b20a5ce6.description: About the Role Asaan | آسان is seeking a Conservation Senior Manager specializing in Objects and Textiles to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for the daily delivery of conservation services for the organization's collections, ensuring their maintenance, conservation, and availability for various stakeholders. The Senior Manager will work under the direction of the Collections Care Director. Key Responsibilities Implement the collections care and conservation strategy and manage the day-to-day conservation work program. Undertake conservation and preservation work and advise on the development of collection policies and procedures. Provide conservation and maintenance support for all collections, ensuring their integrity and security. Support the development and implementation of a strategic plan for collections care and conservation, identifying new areas for development and monitoring performance against objectives. Manage and direct the Collection Conservation team, fostering a collaborative environment, conducting performance evaluations, and providing professional development opportunities. Encourage and support research and scholarship related to the collections, collaborating with academic institutions and presenting findings. Support public programs and exhibitions, working with education and outreach teams to create engaging content and representing the institution at events. Support the Collections Care Director in identifying funding opportunities, cultivating donor relationships, and preparing grant applications. Assist in developing and managing the Collections Care budget, monitoring expenditures, and ensuring financial accountability for conservation activities. Support the implementation of a Disaster Response Plan and undertake regular risk assessments and environmental control audits. Ensure all collection care activities are recorded in the CMS and that staff are trained in its use for documentation. Manage daily operations of the conservation team and facilities, ensuring compliance and a safe environment. fc4163271fe93030.description: مدير متجر إلكتروني (E-commerce Manager) هل لديك خبرة عميقة في التجارة الإلكترونية وسجل مثبت في تحقيق النمو؟ نبحث عن مدير متجر إلكتروني يقود عملياتنا الرقمية ويصنع فرقًا حقيقيًا في الأداء والإيرادات. عن الدور ستكون مسؤولًا عن قيادة وتشغيل وتطوير المتجر الإلكتروني بشكل متكامل، من العمليات اليومية إلى الاستراتيجيات طويلة المدى، مع تركيز واضح على نمو المبيعات وتحسين تجربة العملاء وتعظيم الكفاءة التشغيلية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة وتشغيل المتجر الإلكتروني بكافة جوانبه (المنتجات، الطلبات، المخزون، الشحن). تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات نمو المبيعات وتحسين الأداء التجاري. تحليل البيانات واستخلاص رؤى تدعم اتخاذ القرار (Conversion، AOV، CAC، LTV). تحسين تجربة المستخدم ورفع معدل التحويل وتقليل التخلي عن السلة. الإشراف على قنوات التسويق الرقمي SEO، الإعلانات، وسائل التواصل، البريد الإلكتروني. إدارة فريق العمل والشركاء الخارجيين (تقنيين، شركات شحن، بوابات دفع). متابعة أداء المنصة وضمان استقرارها وتطويرها المستمر. المؤهلات المطلوبة خبرة لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في إدارة المتاجر الإلكترونية أو التجارة الرقمية. سجل إنجازات مثبت في نمو المبيعات وتحقيق مؤشرات أداء قوية. خبرة في منصات التجارة الإلكترونية مثل سله و زد ، شوبيفاي وماجنتو. مهارات تحليلية قوية واتخاذ قرارات مبنية على البيانات. خبرة في إدارة الحملات التسويقية وتحسين العائد على الاستثمار (ROI). مهارات قيادية واتصالية عالية. سمات شخصية عقلية قيادية تركز على النتائج. شغف بالتجارة الرقمية والتقنيات الحديثة. قدرة على العمل في بيئة سريعة التغير. توجه نحو الابتكار والتحسين المستمر. أمثلة على الإنجازات المتوقعة تحقيق نمو ملحوظ في المبيعات خلال فترة قصيرة. تحسين معدل التحويل وتجربة المستخدم بشكل ملموس. خفض تكلفة اكتساب العملاء وزيادة العائد على الاستثمار. طريقة التقديم إذا كنت ترى نفسك مناسبًا لهذا الدور وتمتلك الخبرة والإنجازات المطلوبة، يسعدنا استقبال سيرتك الذاتية مع أمثلة واضحة على إنجازاتك في التجارة الإلكترونية. انضم إلينا وكن جزءًا من رحلة نمو رقمية تصنع أثرًا حقيقيًا.

fca4fb463e62ad7a.description: About the Role Thermo Fisher Scientific is seeking a FSP Local Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) to manage clinical studies locally in Saudi Arabia for one of its clients. This full-time role involves overseeing clinical deliverables for projects of low to moderate complexity, ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and quality standards. Role Purpose and Scope The Clinical Trial Manager is responsible for achieving the final clinical deliverable, typically clean data from evaluable patients as defined in the study protocol, within the timeframe specified in the customer contract. This position involves interpreting data on project issues, making informed business decisions with support, and ensuring all clinical deliverables meet customer expectations regarding time, quality, and cost. The CTM maintains profitability by ensuring clinical activity is conducted within the contract scope through efficient management of the clinical team. Key Responsibilities Manage all clinical operational and quality aspects of allocated studies, of low to moderate complexity, in compliance with ICH GCP. May assume Clinical Study Manager (CSM) responsibilities on smaller or less complex projects. Develop clinical tools such as Monitoring Plans and Monitoring Guidelines in conjunction with the Data Quality Plan. Contribute to the Master Action Plan (MAP) for clinical-related documents. Ensure timely setup, organization, content, and quality of relevant sections of the Trial Master File (local and central). May participate in the design of CRFs, CRF guidelines, and patient informed consent templates. Collaborate with the project manager to prepare, organize, and present at client meetings, including bid defense and hand-off meetings. Communicate regularly with the clinical team and lead team meetings to ensure timelines, resources, interactions, and quality are maintained. Implement and train on standardized clinical monitoring processes within the study and according to corporate standard policies. Ensure timely archiving of documents and study materials for the department. Monitor clinical activity timelines and metrics, provide status updates to the project manager, review projects using tracking tools, implement recovery actions, review monitoring visit reports, and manage CRF collection and query resolution. Continuously monitor or co-monitor clinical trials to assess performance and ensure contractual obligations are met. In smaller regions, may routinely conduct Accompanied Field Visits (AFVs) and be accountable for project financials. Communicate with study sites regarding issues such as protocol, patient participation, and case report form completion. Coordinate all start-up activities and ensure timely ethics committee and regulatory submissions are addressed. Review and follow up on questions raised by ethics committees. Provide input into the preparation of forecast estimates for clinical activities. Manage clinical resources, assign and delegate clinical responsibilities, and identify additional resource requirements. Experience Requirements Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in clinical trial management. Work Environment This role operates primarily in an office environment with exposure to standard electrical office equipment. Frequent driving to site locations and both domestic and international travel are required.

fcc68078c54321dd.description: About the Role Mace is seeking a Senior Construction Manager (Civil) to join their team in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, covering Umluj and Tabuk. Ensure robust quality systems are in place and managed in line with service excellence. Manage project delivery from inception through design, procurement, and construction phases, adhering to the overall programme and agreed milestones. Manage project budgets, identifying and mitigating risks and challenges. Provide technical leadership for civil engineering disciplines across multiple delivery packages. Review engineering designs for compliance with programme requirements and applicable standards. Lead technical reviews related to substructures, earthworks, roads, utilities, structures, and drainage systems. Offer specialist technical guidance on stormwater design and flood management systems. Coordinate technical interfaces between civil and utility disciplines. Review temporary and permanent works proposals and support the resolution of technical design and construction issues. Manage technical risk identification and mitigation activities, and monitor technical performance and compliance during delivery. Lead the construction of MEP services within the project MEP team, ensuring compliance with Mace standards. Manage the site environment, programme, Health Safety & Wellbeing, Quality & Commissioning of the project. Liaise and coordinate with key project stakeholders, including the Client, Consultants, and Trade Contractors. Manage the checking and overseeing of design output to ensure clarity, achievability, and buildability. Prepare and implement delivery strategies and programmes for all project phases. Manage technical aspects of projects, including innovations and continuous improvement plans. Provide performance management, technical development, and coaching to the team. Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills. Commercial and delivery awareness within complex, multidisciplinary programmes. The position involves collaboration with various project and client teams, consultants, and trade contractors within a multidisciplinary programme. Company Values Mace is committed to Safety First, Client Focus, Integrity, and creating Opportunity for its people to excel. The successful candidate will be expected to uphold these values, promoting a diverse and inclusive working environment and contributing to a positive impact for people, clients, and the planet. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this opportunity to contribute to major infrastructure projects with Mace.

fcbe61798dac188e.description: Sanabil Studio is a venture builder that blends industry expertise, technology, and startup know-how to turn bold ideas into real businesses. We take concepts from zero to launch, and when a venture proves its potential, we back it with seed funding and hands-on support to help it scale. We believe the Saudi auto-parts trade is held back by a liquidity gap: garages struggle to get the right parts fast and on fair terms, while suppliers won't carry the payment risk. Whoever closes that gap wins the market. We are a B2B marketplace that supplies large garages in Riyadh with spare parts from vetted wholesalers, owning the ordering, delivery, and, critically, the payments. We give garages workable terms and pay suppliers, carrying the collection risk no one else will. We are the founding team building this venture from concept to a licensed, scaling business, starting with a Riyadh pilot. We are looking for a Co-Founder & Chief Commercial Officer to lead the venture. You will own the two-sided network, supply (wholesalers) and demand (garages), the commercial strategy, and the overall P&L, and you will build and lead the founding team. You will report to the venture's board and the Sanabil Studio Investment Committee. THE ROLE: What you'll own here. Own the overall P&L and go-to-market: take the Riyadh marketplace from pilot to a licensed, scaling business. Build and own the supply side: negotiate discounts, terms, and reliable availability with wholesalers and suppliers. Build and own the demand side: sign, onboard, and grow a base of large garages, and own B2B field sales. Own pricing and margin strategy across both sides (buy-side discount and wholesale-to-retail spread). Build and lead the founding team and the key relationships: wholesalers, garage chains, insurers, and the studio / IC. THE PROFILE: You're probably a fit if… You have 8-12+ years in commercial, GM, or founder roles in the auto aftermarket, B2B distribution/trading, or industrial supply, ideally in KSA/GCC. You have personally signed both suppliers and customers and grown a two-sided or distribution business (a verifiable track record, not just "exposure to"). You deeply understand how the Saudi auto-parts trade actually buys, prices, and pays, and you already have a Riyadh wholesaler/garage/insurer network. You have led a P&L and built and run a team. You communicate clearly with suppliers, garages, insurers, and the studio/board. You are fluent in Arabic and English and based in Riyadh. Bonus: existing relationships with large chains (e.g., Petromin), insurers (e.g., Tawuniya, Najm) or major wholesalers; familiarity with CR / ZATCA / licensing. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE: Within the first 12 months, you'll... Have signed a working base of suppliers and garages and taken the marketplace live at a target monthly order volume. Have delivered validated unit economics and ≥80% on-time collection across live orders. Have hired the core team and established a clear operating cadence. Have a credible path to a licensed, scaling business and the next funding milestone. Be recognised as a decisive leader who aligns the team, partners, and the studio. WHAT THE VENTURE PROVIDES Validated thesis, financial model and market sizing: a de-risked concept with the commercial playbook. Pre-seed capital to build and prove the model, with follow-on support when it works. Operational backbone: legal, finance, hiring, and governance. Hands-on studio support: a venture team working alongside you from day one.

fc7e105b565de221.description: Job description About the job Reverse Circulation Drillers Job Title: RC Driller (Reverse Circulation Drilling) Location: Multiple locations across Saudi Arabia, including Taif and the Eastern Province Nationality: Saudi Nationals Only Employment Type: One-Year Contract, Automatically Renewable Work Rotation: 2 Months On-Site / 1 Month Off (Subject to Confirmation) Working Hours: 12-Hour Shifts Joining: ASAP Job Purpose: Responsible for the safe and efficient operation of Reverse Circulation (RC) drilling rigs, ensuring accurate drilling operations, sample collection, and recovery while maintaining equipment, recording drilling data, and complying with site safety requirements. Key Responsibilities: Operate and maintain Reverse Circulation (RC) drilling rigs safely and efficiently. Conduct RC drilling operations according to project specifications and site requirements. Ensure proper sample collection, recovery, and handling throughout drilling operations. Monitor drilling progress, penetration rates, and drilling conditions. Operate and monitor drilling equipment, including drill rods, bits, and associated tools. Monitor air pressure, drilling fluids, and other operating parameters as required during drilling. Ensure proper operation of the cyclone and sample collection systems. Collect, label, and manage drilling samples to maintain sample quality and prevent contamination. Maintain accurate records of drilling depths, sample intervals, recovery, and operational activities. Identify and report drilling issues, equipment faults, blockages, and changing ground conditions. Perform routine inspections and basic maintenance of drilling equipment. Communicate drilling progress, operational challenges, and equipment requirements to supervisors. Work closely with drilling offsiders and other site personnel to ensure smooth operations. Follow company procedures, client requirements, and site-specific Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) standards. Ensure the proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and safe handling of drilling equipment. Maintain a clean and organized drilling work area. Report incidents, unsafe conditions, and equipment defects promptly. Support operational efficiency, productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications and Experience: High school diploma or equivalent preferred. Approximately 2–3 years of hands-on drilling experience, preferably in Reverse Circulation (RC) drilling. Candidates with relevant practical drilling skills, including trainees with hands-on experience, may be considered. Basic knowledge of RC drilling equipment, drilling procedures, and sample collection techniques. Ability to follow technical instructions and maintain accurate drilling records. Commitment to workplace safety and operational standards. Saudi nationality is mandatory. Required Skills: Practical knowledge of RC drilling operations and equipment. Strong teamwork and communication skills. Basic troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities. Ability to work in remote mining locations and demanding field conditions. Physical fitness to perform drilling-related duties. Willingness to work 12-hour shifts and follow the required rotation schedule. Positive attitude, reliability, and commitment to safety. Salary and Benefits: Basic Salary: To be confirmed. Housing Allowance: As per company policy. Transportation Allowance: SAR 700 per month. GOSI contributions will be deducted in accordance with applicable requirements. Contract Details: One-year contract with automatic annual renewal. Immediate joiners preferred. Candidates with notice periods of up to two months may be considered. Apply now! Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

fc98488dd07057a0.description: About Dnaneer Financing Dnaneer Financing Co. is a Saudi fintech company specializing in debt-based crowdfunding and business financing. Operating under the supervision of the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA), Dnaneer connects investors with businesses seeking financing through a digital platform that leverages technology and automation to provide efficient, transparent, and scalable financing and investment solutions. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Operations Officer, Crowdlending & Financing Operations The Operations Officer is responsible for executing and monitoring Dnaneer’s daily crowdlending operations across the entire financing lifecycle. This includes campaign publication, investor subscriptions, disbursements, repayments, distributions, and reconciliations. The role involves close collaboration with various internal teams, including Credit, Business Development, Finance, Compliance, Technology, and Customer Support. Key Responsibilities Validate campaign terms and supporting documentation against approved financing terms, ensuring all Credit and Compliance approvals are in place before publication. Create, configure, and publish financing campaigns on the crowdlending platform within agreed timelines, monitoring funding progress and closing dates. Process approved amendments, cancellations, and campaign closures. Verify financing agreements and borrower documentation, preparing funded transactions for disbursement. Support investor onboarding and account activation, and process investor subscriptions, verifying allocations and issuing investment confirmations. Manage the repayment cycle, including monitoring schedules, collections, maintaining accurate outstanding balances, and escalating overdue payments. Ensure accurate allocation of repayments between principal, investor returns, and fees, and prepare investor distributions for approval. Conduct daily reconciliation between the platform, bank, payment records, and internal systems, resolving unmatched or failed transactions. Ensure all operational activities comply with approved authorization limits, internal policies, procedures, and SAMA requirements. Maintain complete, accurate, and traceable records and audit trails for all transactions. Identify and escalate discrepancies, operational risks, suspicious activity, and policy exceptions. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports covering funding, disbursements, repayments, distributions, and SLA performance. Identify bottlenecks and collaborate with Product and Technology teams to automate processes. Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) for new platform features and maintain SOPs and operational checklists. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in operations, preferably within financial services or fintech. Demonstrated ability to manage complex operational workflows and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. Strong analytical skills for reconciliation and reporting. Experience working in a cross-functional environment. Performance Metrics Performance will be evaluated against operational targets and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) established by Operations management. Key performance indicators include campaign publication SLA, control compliance, transaction accuracy, distribution timeliness, reconciliation completion, and measurable improvements in process efficiency. Career Development This role offers exposure to digital financing, debt-based crowdfunding, and investor operations within a dynamic, cross-functional team. It provides opportunities for professional development and contributing to the growth of Saudi Arabia’s fintech ecosystem.

fc57870bc2c2e869.description: About the Role AECOM Saudi Arabia is seeking a Sr. Resident Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position requires a highly experienced professional to oversee site activities and ensure compliance with project specifications for road, railway, and construction projects. Role Overview The Senior Resident Engineer will be responsible for the comprehensive supervision and management of construction activities. This includes ensuring adherence to approved designs and standards, coordinating with various stakeholders, and maintaining project quality and safety throughout the execution phase. Key Responsibilities Supervise and manage construction activities for road, railway, and infrastructure projects. Ensure works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements. Coordinate with the client, contractor, and consultants to resolve technical and site-related issues. Monitor project progress, quality, safety, and compliance with project standards. Review contractor submissions, method statements, and technical documentation. Lead site inspections and ensure proper implementation of quality control procedures. Prepare and review progress reports and provide technical recommendations. Manage and coordinate site supervision teams. Identify potential project risks and support timely resolution of issues. Ensure compliance with contractual requirements and relevant engineering standards. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in road, railway, and construction projects is required. Demonstrated experience in overseeing site activities and ensuring compliance with project specifications. Proven ability to coordinate effectively with clients, contractors, and project teams. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a project-focused environment, collaborating with various teams and external stakeholders to deliver complex infrastructure projects. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

fc62adad1c8052e8.description: Job Summary HUDSON is seeking a qualified Cost Controller/Engineer to join our team in Al Jubail, Eastern Province. This full-time role requires strong experience within the Oil & Gas industry, with a preference for candidates who have worked on EPC and/or Shutdown & Turnaround (SD/TA) projects. Role Overview The Cost Controller/Engineer will be responsible for managing and overseeing cost-related activities for projects, ensuring financial control and reporting accuracy. This position is crucial for maintaining project budgets and contributing to efficient project execution, particularly within complex industrial environments. Key Requirements Strong experience in the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, or Refinery industry. Demonstrated experience with Shutdown & Turnaround (SD/TA) projects is highly preferred. Experience with EPC projects is also preferred. Relevant Mechanical Engineering qualification. Candidates with prior experience in Saudi Arabia or the GCC region will be preferred. A strong background in mechanical engineering is a fundamental requirement for this role. fc69951abf4da5ac.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Procurement Coordinator to manage end-to-end procurement activities. This full-time position involves coordinating all stages from material requisition through to final delivery, ensuring compliance with company procedures and project requirements. The role is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Receive and review Purchase Requisitions (PRs), ensuring all required specifications and approvals are in place. Obtain and compare quotations from approved suppliers and vendors. Prepare Request for Quotations (RFQs), bid comparisons, purchase orders, and other necessary procurement documentation. Coordinate with suppliers regarding pricing, availability, lead times, payment terms, and delivery schedules. Regularly follow up on Purchase Order (PO) status, manufacturing, dispatch, and delivery. Maintain an updated procurement tracking and expediting report. Coordinate with project, engineering, warehouse, logistics, and finance teams to resolve procurement-related issues. Support vendor evaluation, registration, and the maintenance of an approved supplier database. Ensure all procurement activities comply with company procedures, project requirements, and commercial terms. Monitor material delivery against project schedules and escalate potential delays. Verify supplier documentation, including quotations, invoices, delivery notes, certificates, and compliance documents. Assist in resolving discrepancies related to quantity, quality, pricing, and delivery. Coordinate with the finance department for invoice verification and payment processing. Maintain proper records of PRs, RFQs, quotations, POs, contracts, and supplier correspondence. Support cost-saving initiatives through supplier negotiation and competitive sourcing. Prepare regular procurement status reports for management. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 0-1 years of experience in procurement or a related field. Demonstrated ability to coordinate complex procurement activities. Work Type This is a full-time position within Larsen & Toubro.

fc71a4e9e4ae83af.description: About Jacobs Engineering Group Inc. Jacobs Engineering Group Inc. is dedicated to addressing critical global challenges across various sectors, including urban development, environmental resilience, and scientific discovery. The company focuses on transforming concepts into tangible solutions that contribute positively to the world. The Role of Senior Structural Engineer Jacobs is seeking a Senior Structural Engineer to join the team in Neom, Tabuk, or Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing contractual leadership across a major program, managing all structural engineering aspects from detailed design through project completion. The Senior Structural Engineer will ensure compliance with industry standards, safety regulations, and client requirements for various structure types, including concrete, precast elements, steel, composite structures, and infrastructure. The position requires reviewing and analyzing design reports, drawings, and calculations, and proposing technical solutions. Key Responsibilities Review and validate structural and infrastructure designs, including calculations, models, drawings, shop drawings, and technical reports, to ensure safety, durability, and compliance. Assess structural analysis outputs using engineering software such as SAP2000, SAFE, and ETABS. Review and approve material mix designs for concrete, asphalt, and other structural and infrastructure materials. Evaluate material testing reports for concrete, reinforcement steel, structural steel, asphalt, and backfill materials to verify quality and compliance. Review geotechnical and soil investigation reports to support design validation and construction decisions. Provide technical support and problem-solving, including responding to contractor queries and evaluating structural modifications for site conditions. Ensure compliance with project specifications, quality standards, and local/international codes and regulations. Lead technical coordination meetings with contractors and stakeholders to resolve engineering issues and review submissions. Coordinate and mentor engineering teams, fostering collaboration across multidisciplinary disciplines and guiding junior staff. Manage stakeholder engagement and conflict resolution, communicating technical requirements effectively and delivering practical engineering solutions. Qualifications and Requirements Over 10 years of experience in structural engineering. Proficiency in structural analysis software such as SAP2000, SAFE, and ETABS. Strong understanding of industry standards, safety regulations, and local/international codes. Ability to review and validate complex engineering designs and reports. Experience in leading and managing structural engineering aspects of major programs. Work Environment and Company Culture Jacobs promotes a culture of care, supporting diverse perspectives and backgrounds. The company emphasizes safety and flexibility, offering support and resources to maximize employee potential. Onsite employees are expected to attend a Jacobs workplace on a full-time basis, as required by the nature of their role. Location This position is available in All SA Regions, specifically in Neom, Tabuk, and Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

fc8e52a05901d8b0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التحسين العالمية عن أخصائي إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تحليل عناصر المشروع وفعالياته، ووضع الخطط الزمنية، ومتابعة التنفيذ لضمان سير المشاريع بكفاءة وفعالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهنيين الطموحين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحليل عناصر وفعاليات المشروع، وتحديد ارتباطاتها وترتيبها، ودراسة قيمة المشروع وحجمه، ثم إعداد برنامج زمني وترتيب الإجراءات اللازمة. تحديد الموارد المادية والبشرية المطلوبة لتنفيذ المشروع ومتابعة توفيرها في التوقيتات المناسبة. إعداد جدول تدفق نقدي يتناسب مع تسلسل تنفيذ فعاليات المشروع. مراجعة التنفيذ والتقدم الفعلي للمشروع ومقارنته بالبرنامج المخطط، وإعداد البرامج المعدلة والمنقحة، بالإضافة إلى تطوير أساليب وتقنيات العمل باستخدام التقنيات الحديثة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بإدارة المشاريع، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال إدارة المشاريع أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل عناصر المشروع ووضع الخطط والبرامج الزمنية. مهارات في إعداد برامج التدفق النقدي وتحليل المخاطر المتوقعة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتطوير أساليب العمل. بيئة العمل يقع مقر هذا الدور في جدة، مكة المكرمة، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل تتطلب الالتزام بمهام إدارة المشاريع ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية ضمن فريق عمل متخصص. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة التحسين العالمية.

fc8ed3cdeb42c18c.description: About Black Sip Coffee Roasters Black Sip Coffee Roasters is a Saudi specialty coffee brand dedicated to sourcing, roasting, and delivering high-quality coffee to cafés, businesses, and enthusiasts across the Kingdom. The company focuses on transparency, craftsmanship, and consistent quality throughout the coffee journey, from green bean selection to precise roasting and profile development. Team members contribute to a growing brand that values expertise, attention to detail, and a shared commitment to elevating the coffee experience. The Role of Financial Accountant Black Sip Coffee Roasters is seeking a Financial Accountant for a full-time, on-site position based in Bishah, 'Asir, Saudi Arabia. This role is responsible for preparing, reviewing, and maintaining accurate financial statements and records in accordance with applicable standards and internal policies. The Financial Accountant will support financial operations, reporting, and compliance within the company. Key Responsibilities Record and post daily financial transactions and journal entries accurately into the system. Manage accounts receivable (AR) and accounts payable (AP), including supervising invoices, collections, and vendor payments. Prepare, review, and perform periodic bank reconciliations. Prepare monthly and periodic financial reports and statements, monitoring revenues and expenses to ensure correct accounting treatment. Review employee advances, petty cash, and expense claims, and perform necessary balance reconciliations for both customers and suppliers. Prepare and process payroll, ensuring the accuracy of all related financial data. Monitor tax obligations and prepare all required tax documents and regulatory reports. Assist in the preparation of company budgets and financial forecasts. Maintain, organize, and archive accounting records and supporting documents, coordinating with management and external auditors during audits. Ensure full compliance with internal financial policies, procedures, and applicable accounting regulations. Daily Operations and Support Day-to-day tasks include recording journal entries, reconciling accounts, and managing payables and receivables. The role supports month-end and year-end closing activities, prepares regular financial reports, and assists with budgeting and forecasting. The Financial Accountant will also provide analytical insights to support decision-making and cost control, work with accounting software, and collaborate with internal teams to improve financial processes and controls. Compliance and Auditing This position involves supporting audits and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. The Financial Accountant will maintain organized accounting records and supporting documents, coordinating directly with management and external auditors as needed. Location and Work Type This is a full-time, on-site position located in Bishah, 'Asir, Saudi Arabia.

fc9a2b293c1b856f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الدكان عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع، بالإضافة إلى متابعة التحصيلات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل هذه الوظيفة إلى جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات، وإعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمحتملين. كما يتولى مسؤولية التواصل مع العملاء لتقديم عروض البيع، إتمام الصفقات، ومتابعة تحصيل الديون، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الدورية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء، سواء عبر الهاتف أو الزيارات الميدانية، لترويج المنتجات والخدمات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عمليات البيع، وتحرير الفواتير، وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، وتوريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع البيانات وتحليلها بشكل فعال. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. سيعمل الموظف ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف الشركة وتوسيع قاعدة عملائها. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. نشجع المرشحين المؤهلين على التقديم.

fc9f27463fc6a809.description: About Red Sea Global and Botanica Red Sea Global is a visionary developer focused on redefining sustainability and creating lasting impact. Botanica, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, specializes in providing sustainable greenery across Red Sea Global’s destinations, ensuring the careful integration of new species with local flora. Operating across Umluj and Tabuk, Botanica manages over 1 million square meters of landscape and aims to cultivate 30 million plants by 2030, contributing to the natural landscapes of The Red Sea & Amaala. Role Summary The Supervisor Landscape Maintenance is responsible for overseeing and coordinating daily landscape maintenance operations. This full-time role ensures that all landscaped areas meet high standards of quality, safety, and presentation. The supervisor will manage workforce deployment, softscape maintenance, irrigation coordination, and plant health monitoring to ensure timely completion of maintenance activities. Key Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate all daily landscape maintenance activities within assigned areas. Plan daily work schedules and allocate manpower based on operational priorities and site requirements. Oversee the maintenance of trees, palms, shrubs, groundcovers, lawns, and seasonal plants. Supervise horticultural activities including pruning, trimming, mowing, planting, fertilization, weeding, mulching, and plant replacement. Conduct regular site inspections to ensure landscape areas meet required quality and presentation standards. Monitor plant health and identify issues such as irrigation problems, pests, diseases, and nutrient deficiencies. Coordinate with the irrigation team regarding performance, leaks, blockages, damaged components, and watering schedules. Ensure effective utilization of manpower, tools, machinery, equipment, and landscape materials. Monitor stock and material requirements, coordinating timely availability of fertilizers, chemicals, plants, soil, and other maintenance materials. Ensure compliance with HSE procedures, PPE requirements, toolbox talks, and safe working practices. Prepare daily and weekly reports covering manpower, completed works, pending activities, materials, equipment, and operational issues. Coordinate with Landscape Management, Irrigation, Nursery, HSE, Facilities, Logistics, and other support functions. Identify operational challenges, manpower shortages, quality concerns, or delays and escalate them to the Line Manager. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in landscape maintenance supervision. Demonstrated ability to supervise and coordinate daily landscape operations. Proficiency in horticultural practices and plant health monitoring. Experience in ensuring compliance with safety and quality standards. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Tabuk, with operations spanning Umluj. The role involves working within a team dedicated to sustainable development and ecological harmony, contributing to world-class projects in natural locations. Application Process Candidates interested in this Supervisor Landscape Maintenance role are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

fc9f84e391620ebc.description: About the Role Virtucruit is seeking a highly professional and confident Executive Assistant to provide support to senior leadership. This full-time role involves representing the organization and engaging with key stakeholders, and is available in Riyadh and Dammam. Role Overview The Executive Assistant will serve as a key point of contact, supporting leadership during various engagements and ensuring professional representation of the company. The position requires strong communication skills and a focus on stakeholder interaction, events, and public relations initiatives. Key Responsibilities Provide executive support during meetings, events, and official engagements. Welcome and engage with VIP guests, partners, and key stakeholders. Represent the organization professionally in internal and external interactions. Communicate effectively in both Arabic and English, verbally and in writing. Support media, communications, and public-facing initiatives. Build and maintain a professional online presence aligned with the company's brand. Coordinate local and international engagements as required. Handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism. Required Qualifications and Skills Excellent communication and presentation skills in both Arabic and English. Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills. Professional appearance and confident personality. Interest in public relations, communications, media, events, or stakeholder engagement. Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Willingness to travel when required. Application Process Candidates who are confident communicators, enjoy working with people, and are capable of representing organizations professionally in a dynamic environment are encouraged to apply.

fca1a9152f0b3cf7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إعمار الخليج للاستشارات الهندسية عن فني مساحة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة المتنوعة للمشاريع الهندسية، بما في ذلك الأبنية والطرق والبنية التحتية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستكشافية للمشاريع الإنشائية المختلفة وإعداد مسودات بالمنشآت والعوائق والقنوات والطرق الفرعية. تحديد وتثبيت نقاط الاستناد الرئيسة والفرعية ونقاط الربط، واختيار الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية اللازمة. إجراء أعمال التسوية الطولية والعرضية لشبكات البنية التحتية المتنوعة. تنفيذ أعمال التسوية الشبكية لمشاريع الأبنية والأراضي، وتثبيت مواقع وحدود الأبنية من المخططات على الأرض. نقل مواقع وحدود الأبنية القائمة وتثبيتها على المخططات، وتثبيت مناسيب جميع الأعمال المتعلقة بالمشروع. تثبيت مسارات الطرق وسكك الحديد وتقاطعاتها، وتوقيع المنحنيات المختلفة وفقاً للمخططات. رسم المقاطع العرضية والطولية والمنحنيات الأفقية والرأسية والمخططات الكنتورية والمساحية المستخدمة في أعمال المساحة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المساحة. القدرة على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستطلاعية والتسوية المساحية. مهارة في رسم الخرائط والمخططات المساحية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني المساحة بدوام كامل في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق شركة إعمار الخليج للاستشارات الهندسية. يتطلب الدور العمل الميداني والمكتبي حسب طبيعة المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة إعمار الخليج للاستشارات الهندسية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

fca74462b810be21.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking an Executive Sales professional to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time role involves managing guest interactions, processing reservations, and supporting sales and marketing efforts while upholding Marriott's brand standards and guest loyalty. Utilize sales techniques to maximize revenue, including up-selling, while maintaining guest loyalty to Marriott. Determine and provide complimentary gifts to guests as a token of appreciation for their patronage, such as rewards points, show tickets, or gift certificates. Promote awareness of the Marriott brand image both internally and externally. Process requests for redeeming Marriott Rewards points. Handle all reservation requests, changes, and cancellations received via phone, fax, or mail. Enter Marriott Rewards information into the appropriate software when taking guest reservations. Answer, record, and process all guest calls, requests, questions, or concerns. Perform general office duties to support the Sales & Marketing department, including filing, sending emails, typing, and faxing. Team Support and Professional Conduct Assist management in training and motivating employees, serving as a role model. Adhere to all company policies and procedures, ensuring a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address their service needs, and express genuine appreciation. Communicate professionally and clearly, prepare and review written documents accurately, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues, support the team in achieving common goals, and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Monitor the performance of others to ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience. Ability to read and visually verify information in various formats. Capable of moving, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, and placing objects weighing up to 10 pounds without assistance. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, within the Marriott International team. The role focuses on understanding fragrance behaviour after formulation, identifying performance issues, and supporting solutions. Role Objective The primary objective of this role is to identify and address issues that can lead to commercial failure despite initial positive evaluations. These issues include rapid loss of projection, unbalanced dry-downs, changes after storage, discolouration, oxidation, heat instability, inconsistent performance on skin and fabric, and loss of volatile top notes. The scientist will work across perfumery, formulation, raw materials, analytical evaluation, and product development to support technically credible solutions. Key Responsibilities Evaluate fine-fragrance performance, including longevity, diffusion, and substantivity. Compare fragrance modifications and different concentrations. Develop structured performance-testing protocols for skin, blotter, and fabric. Conduct accelerated stability studies and assess performance at elevated temperatures. Monitor colour, clarity, and odour changes during storage; investigate oxidation and degradation. Evaluate raw-material interactions and identify components affecting projection or longevity. Support perfumers during formula optimisation and assist in alcohol-based and oil-based perfume development. Evaluate concentrated perfume oils and attars. Benchmark competitive Saudi, GCC, and international fragrances. Maintain structured stability and performance documentation. Support technical discussions with fragrance houses and raw-material suppliers. Required Qualifications and Experience Minimum 6 years of professional fragrance, perfume, or cosmetics R&D experience. Direct professional experience in fragrance stability or performance testing. Strong knowledge of fragrance raw materials and their behaviour. Experience evaluating longevity, diffusion, and substantivity. Experience with accelerated stability studies and alcohol-based fragrance systems. Experience with concentrated or oil-based perfume systems is strongly preferred. Understanding of oxidation and fragrance degradation. Familiarity with IFRA requirements and strong technical documentation skills. Experience supporting perfumers or fragrance-development teams is preferred. GCC or Middle Eastern fragrance experience is strongly advantageous. Compensation and Environment This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah Province, Saudi Arabia. The indicative fixed monthly compensation ranges from SAR 22,000 to 34,000, depending on direct fragrance-industry experience, technical capability, and seniority. The role offers exposure to fragrance-development projects involving international raw-material suppliers, natural aromatic ingredients, essential oils, fine fragrance, Arabian perfumery, and GCC-specific performance requirements.

fc5b7916e02464c2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نمو اعمال للتشغيل والصيانة عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بدراسة المخططات، تقدير المواد، متابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال لضمان سلامة وكفاءة الأنظمة الكهربائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية لمختلف المنشآت (المنزلية، الصناعية، التجارية) ومكوناتها. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية المطلوبة وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية وفحصها، بما في ذلك فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض، ومتابعة تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بأنواع المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد الحلول المناسبة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات فنية قوية في تركيب وصيانة التمديدات الكهربائية. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرار. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. تفاصيل العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في بريدة، القصيم. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة نمو اعمال للتشغيل والصيانة.

fc71aa412ac2ffd6.description: About Lucid Motors Middle East Lucid Motors is dedicated to creating advanced mobility experiences through innovation, driving the world forward. The company's vehicles are built on proprietary technology and a software-defined architecture, reflecting a "Compromise Nothing™" approach to the global automotive market. This involves integrating performance with sustainability, and design with engineering. Lucid achieves this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production managed in-house across global offices and manufacturing facilities. Position Overview: Automation Engineer PWT Lucid Motors Middle East is seeking an Automation Engineer PWT for an internship position in Saudi Arabia. This is a hands-on technical contributor role responsible for developing, commissioning, sustaining, and improving various automation systems across AMP-2 Drive Unit and HV Battery assembly. The role supports equipment acceptance from FAT/SAT through Safe Launch, volume ramp, and stable production, ensuring compliance with Lucid controls and production system standards, functional safety, OT cybersecurity, and change-control protocols. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Develop, test, and sustain PLC programs, function blocks/AOIs, data structures, and interfaces for DU and HV Battery equipment using approved coding, tag, alarm, diagnostic, and documentation standards. Manage all software changes through backup, impact/risk assessment, peer review, approval, validation, revision history, rollback readiness, and post-change archiving. Troubleshoot PLC, I/O, sequencing, interlock, electrical, network, and safety-circuit faults; complete RCA, permanent corrective action, and maintain current backups/drawings/change records. Execute controls FAT/SAT covering I/O, sequence logic, permissive, interlocks, alarms, recovery/restart, safety functions, cycle performance, and data interfaces; review supplier controls deliverables against AMP-2 specifications. Develop HMI/SCADA screens, alarms, events, diagnostics, equipment states, recovery guidance, and historian tags to improve troubleshooting and MTTR. Integrate PLCs with MES/APM/LMIS using approved tags, OPC-UA, handshakes, and messaging; validate machine states, counts, rejects, quality results, downtime, serial transactions, genealogy, and end-to-end traceability. Configure and troubleshoot EtherNet/IP, managed switches, addressing, and field-device communications, adhering to OT cybersecurity protocols. Deploy and troubleshoot vision systems (*, Cognex, Keyence) for inspection, orientation, label verification, error-proofing, and traceability; support FANUC Robots cells at PLC/I/O, handshake, safety, recovery, and cycle level. Commission and troubleshoot VFDs, servos, encoders, positioning/homing, actuators, and controls interfaces for various manufacturing processes. Support safety PLC changes and validation under ISO 13849/IEC 62061 governance; comply with SASO, applicable Saudi labor requirements, IEC 60204, machine/stored-energy LOTO, electrical safe work, HV LOTO/HVIL, and PPE. Provide controls support from commissioning through sustaining production; analyze downtime, repeat stops, nuisance alarms, cycle loss, communication faults, and recovery delay, then verify permanent countermeasures. Deliver structured OJT, practical assessment, competency progression, training material, troubleshooting guides, matrices, and training plans for Saudi engineers/technicians. Qualifications and Experience 3-5 years of experience in automation engineering or a related field. Proficiency in PLC programming, HMI/SCADA/Ignition systems, industrial networks, vision systems, robotics interfaces, and motion control. Experience with MES/APM integration. Knowledge of functional safety, OT cybersecurity, and change-control standards. Ability to conduct FAT/SAT and manage equipment acceptance processes. Strong troubleshooting skills for electrical, network, and safety-circuit faults. Familiarity with ISO 13849/IEC 62061 governance and relevant Saudi compliance standards. Work Environment and Collaboration This role involves working in a dynamic manufacturing environment, supporting production from commissioning through sustaining operations. The Automation Engineer will collaborate with various teams including Production, Maintenance, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, EHS, IT/OT, MES, suppliers, and global technical teams. A key aspect of the role is accountability for controls reliability, traceability, fault recovery, uptime, and capability transfer to Saudi engineers and technicians, contributing to Saudization initiatives.

fc8d32c3badd406a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الجابري اخوان للنقليات عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، بالمنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ سياسات البيع ومتابعة أدائها لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع، وتقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع، وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية واضحة. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية لتعزيز المبيعات. التواصل الفعال مع الزبائن لتحديد مشكلاتهم واحتياجاتهم، ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المحتملة. تقييم أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيقهم للأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لتحسين الأداء. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على وضع سياسات واستراتيجيات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم أداء المبيعات وتحديد فرص التحسين. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتفاعل مع الزبائن والفرق الداخلية. القدرة على تحليل السوق والمنافسين لتحديد التحديات والفرص. مهارات إعداد التقارير وتقديم العروض التقديمية بوضوح. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتحفيز مندوبي المبيعات. بيئة العمل الدور متاح بنظام الدوام الكامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل أخصائي المبيعات ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي، ويسهم بشكل مباشر في تحقيق الأهداف التجارية للشركة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه لتقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في الجابري اخوان للنقليات.
